sections.title: Grade 1 foundations
sections.description: Letters, sounds and first words from Grade 1 that every reader needs.

questions.question: Which day comes just before Saturday?
questions.options: Friday | Thursday | Monday | Sunday
questions.explanation: In the week, Friday comes first and then Saturday follows it.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.options: She likes mangoes | She like mangoes. | She liking mangoes. | She likes mangoes.
questions.explanation: With he or she we add -s to the verb, and a sentence ends with a full stop: 'She likes mangoes.'

questions.question: Who is the helper who puts out fires?
questions.options: A reporter | A window cleaner | A bus driver | A firefighter
questions.explanation: A firefighter is the brave helper who puts out fires and keeps people safe.

questions.question: Read the sentence: 'My neighbour is a doctor. She helps people who are ___.' Which word fits the gap?
questions.options: sick | empty | loud | green
questions.explanation: A doctor helps people who are sick, so 'sick' is the word that fits.

questions.question: Which body part bends in the middle of your leg when you run and jump?
questions.options: Chin | Knee | Ear | Thumb
questions.explanation: Your knee is the joint in the middle of your leg that bends when you run and jump.

questions.question: Read the two sentences: 'The sun shines in the day. The moon shines at night.' When does the moon shine?
questions.options: In the morning | At night | At noon | In the day
questions.explanation: The sentence tells us the moon shines at night — good reading detective work!

questions.question: Which word means the brightness from the sun that lets us see?
questions.options: Shadow | Light | Night | Thunder
questions.explanation: Light is the brightness that lets our eyes see the world around us.

questions.question: Which number word means 90?
questions.options: Ninth | Ninety | Nine | Nineteen
questions.explanation: Ninety is the number 90. Nineteen is 19 and ninth tells us a position in a line.

questions.question: Which sentence compares two animals correctly?
questions.options: A giraffe is taller a horse. | A giraffe is taller than a horse. | A giraffe is more tall than a horse. | A giraffe is tall than a horse.
questions.correctAnswer: A giraffe is taller than a horse.
questions.explanation: To compare two things we add -er to a short describing word and use 'than': taller than.

questions.question: We use a ruler to ___ how long something is.
questions.options: pour | sing | taste | measure
questions.explanation: A ruler helps us measure length — how long or short something is.

questions.question: Which word begins with the same sound as 'bug'?
questions.options: ant | ball | sun | fish
questions.explanation: Bug and ball both begin with the /b/ sound — b-b-bug, b-b-ball!

questions.question: Read the clue: 'This small creature has eight legs and spins a web.' What is it?
questions.options: A spider | A bee | An ant | A butterfly
questions.explanation: A spider has eight legs and spins a sticky web to catch its food.

questions.question: Which sentence uses 'There are' correctly?
questions.options: There is two beds in the room. | There are is two beds in the room. | There are a bed in the room. | There are two beds in the room.
questions.correctAnswer: There are two beds in the room.
questions.explanation: We say 'There is' for one thing and 'There are' for more than one — two beds needs 'There are'.

questions.question: The ball rolled ___ the bed, so we could not see it any more.
questions.options: on | under | between | above
questions.explanation: If the ball is under the bed, it is hidden below it — that is why we cannot see it.

questions.question: Where do you go to post a letter?
questions.options: The post office | The swimming pool | The playground | The bakery
questions.explanation: The post office is the place in the city where we post letters and parcels.

questions.question: A friend asks for directions. Which word completes the answer? 'Go straight and then ___ left at the corner.'
questions.options: turn | close | drink | sleep
questions.explanation: When we give directions we say 'turn left' or 'turn right' to change direction.

questions.question: Which question asks about a birthday correctly?
questions.options: When is your birthday? | Your birthday when is? | Is when your birthday? | When your birthday is?
questions.explanation: A question starts with the question word, then the verb: 'When is your birthday?'

questions.question: Which letter makes the first sound in 'sun'?
questions.options: C | S | T | Z
questions.explanation: Sun starts with the /s/ sound, and the letter S makes that sound — sss-sun!

questions.question: Which is the lowercase partner of the letter B?
questions.options: q | p | b | d
questions.explanation: Big B and little b are partners — the same letter in two sizes.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'cat'?
questions.options: fish | pen | hat | dog
questions.explanation: Cat and hat both end with the -at sound, so they rhyme.

questions.question: Which classroom object do you write with?
questions.options: A lunchbox | A chair | A pencil | A clock
questions.explanation: We hold a pencil in our hand to write letters and words.

questions.question: Which sentence is in the correct order?
questions.options: Can a see I cat. | I can see a cat. | See can I a cat. | A cat I see can.
questions.explanation: English sentences follow an order: who, then the doing words — 'I can see a cat.'

questions.question: Your mother's mother is your ___.
questions.options: sister | teacher | grandmother | friend
questions.explanation: Your mother's mother is your grandmother — a special member of your family.

questions.question: Which animal lives on a farm and gives us milk?
questions.options: A zebra | An elephant | A lion | A cow
questions.explanation: A cow lives on the farm and gives us the milk we drink.

questions.question: Which part of your body do you use to smell a flower?
questions.options: Your knee | Your ear | Your nose | Your hand
questions.explanation: Smelling is one of your five senses, and your nose is the part that does it.

questions.question: Which one flies high in the sky?
questions.options: A train | A bus | A boat | A plane
questions.explanation: A plane flies high in the sky; buses, boats and trains stay on land or water.

questions.question: Read the sentence: 'Rain falls from the ___.' Which word fits the gap?
questions.options: table | sky | shoe | ground
questions.explanation: Rain falls down from the clouds in the sky onto the ground.

questions.question: Which place in the city has many books you can borrow?
questions.options: The market | The park | The library | The zoo
questions.explanation: The library is full of books, and you can borrow them to read at home.
